usbeehive_path.label: usbeehive binary
usbeehive_path.description: Command name on PATH, or an absolute / ~ path (e.g. ~/.cargo/bin/usbeehive)

poll_interval_s.label: Wattage refresh (seconds)
poll_interval_s.description: How often to re-read power while a USB-C port is charging

hide_internal.label: Hide internal devices
hide_internal.description: Hide devices the kernel marks as fixed (built-in Bluetooth, webcams, card readers)

notify_hotplug.label: Notify on connect / disconnect
notify_hotplug.description: Show a notification when a USB device is plugged in or removed

notify_warnings.label: Notify on charging problems
notify_warnings.description: Show a notification when usbeehive detects a cable or charger bottleneck

idle_display.label: When not charging
idle_display.description: What the bar widget shows when no USB-C power is flowing

error.stream_failed: Could not start the usbeehive watcher.
